semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes, including die bonding and wafer level bonding.
summary: Chia Sheng Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and distributes equipment for the semiconductor, LCD, and lithium battery industries. They offer products such as die bonding equipment, wafer level bonders, and cleaning and washing equipment for assembly and packaging. The company focuses on providing integrated solutions tailored to customer needs, particularly in microLED process integration.
